Are duties/tariffs and customs clearance included? Do I need to unload it? What happens if something arrives damaged?  I’m definitely still learning, but I’m sharing the things I have learned to make this process easier for someone else. And now we wait to see if my first order actually makes it to Ohio. 😂🤞🏼#buyfromchina #alibaba #customhome #BuildingAHouse #homebuildingtips
